title: Unsafe to operate controls while driving
summary: Reviews in this topic focus on controls that require driver attention away from the road, with most sampled fragments marked undetermined and one explicitly negative design complaint.

negative.summary: The negative review describes the driving-related interaction as feeling unsafe and calls it a poor design decision.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention feeling unsafe when using functions while driving, especially when controls require looking away from the road or using infotainment for temperature changes.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment evidence is limited.
The examples are narrowly focused on perceived distraction from using controls while driving, so broader safety context is not available from this sample.
